coverage_notes: The incorporated Acceptable Use Policy and Meta brand guidelines are referenced but not supplied; their specific requirements are excluded and not inferred. The local duties and restrictions stated in the agreement are covered by existing anchors.

Section 6 expressly requires deletion of Llama Materials upon termination. Deletion has no faithful representation in the allowed activity vocabulary; the separate cessation-of-use rule is covered by an existing anchor.

paragraph_audit.reason: The local duty to comply with applicable laws and regulations, including trade compliance laws, and adhere to the incorporated Acceptable Use Policy is covered by the existing clause. The referenced policy text is absent, so its specific requirements are excluded.

The local restrictions on names and marks, limited Llama Mark license, and brand-guidelines duty are covered by existing clauses. The referenced brand guidelines are absent, so their specific requirements are excluded.

The existing clause covers the express duty to cease using Llama Materials upon termination. The separate express duty to delete those materials upon termination is operative but deletion is not an allowed activity and cannot be faithfully represented.
